design_direction: Architectural editorial layout in warm limestone, pine and terracotta. Original isometric hardscape drawing, generous serif headlines, numbered service index, persistent verified phone contact. No invented project photographs or testimonials.

opportunity.observation: The desktop home page opens with an oversized brand header and a nearly full-screen project photograph. No phone number, service summary or direct call action appears in the initial viewport; the phone is plain footer text. The concept brings the hardscaping offer and a callable number above the fold. This is a design hypothesis, not evidence of lost sales. The site also displays a future 2035 copyright year.
opportunity.comparison_evidence: Direct desktop browser screenshot plus the mobile final screenshot in a current PageSpeed Insights report inspected. Both initial views lack a visible direct phone action. The current site works; the proposed improvement is clearer contact hierarchy, not an assertion of measured sales loss.
opportunity.reason: Public business-owned email and international phone match the home and contact pages. A bounded Gmail identity/domain search found no prior correspondence. Genuine business lead with a concrete contact-hierarchy proposal, not a claimed buyer.
